Name: Assail
Description: A basic attack that deals a small amount of damage to an enemy immediately in front of you.

Name: Strike
Description: Warrior's basic attack.

Name: Slash
Description: An attack that strikes your front and increases target AC.

Name: Inspect
Description: Allows an aisling to study an item's attributes.

Name: Look
Description: Allows an aisling to study a map.

Name: nis
Description: Allows an aisling to check on Unora's current time.

Name: Wind Blade
Description: Deals minor damage to 3 tiles in front of you.

Name: Clobber
Description: Warrior's second basic attack. Replaces Strike.

Name: Scathe
Description: Hits the front and sides of the user.

Name: Flurry
Description: The warrior explodes, releasing slashes around them.

Name: Flank
Description: Assail that hits in front and sides. Replaces Clobber.

Name: Beag Suain
Description: Paralyze an enemy in front of you for a short time.

Name: Ao Beag Suain
Description: Removes beag suain, allowing you to move.

Name: Sunder
Description: A strong attack that strikes your front and increases target AC. Replaces Slash.

Name: Wallop
Description: Warrior's third basic attack. Replaces Flank.

Name: Cleave
Description: A strong attack that strikes your front and sides. Replaces Scathe.

Name: Throw
Description: Allows an aisling to throw an entity away from them.

Name: Two Handed Attack
Description: Warrior's Two Handed Attack.

Name: Crasher
Description: A massive damage attack. Deploy your current health as a frontal strike.

Name: Bull Rush
Description: Charges you forward 2 tiles and breaks the armor of the target. Upgrades Sunder.

Name: Execute
Description: Can kill weak enemies. Restores health and reduces cooldown on success.

Name: Tempest Blade
Description: Deals damage 3 tiles in front of you. Replaces Windblade.

Name: Pulverize
Description: Warrior's fourth basic attack. Replaces Wallop.

Name: Ground Stomp
Description: Paralyze enemies in your front and sides for a short time.

Name: Charge
Description: Charges you forward 4 tiles and breaks the armor of the target. Replaces Bull Rush.

Name: Shockwave
Description: Deals major damage to enemies in front of you.

Name: Thrash
Description: Master Warrior's basic attack. Replaces Pulverize.

Name: Sever
Description: Deals major damage to enemies 4 spaces in front of you. Replaces Tempest Blade.

Name: Mad Soul
Description: Surge of raging energy, striking all nearby enemies within a range of 3 with devastating force. Pure only.

Name: Annihilate
Description: Can kill weak enemies. Restores health and reduces cooldown on success. Pure only.

Name: Sneak Attack
Description: Gives the warrior a surprise attack. Pure only.

Name: Onslaught
Description: Assail that hits in front and sides. Pure only.

Name: Slaughter
Item Requirement(s): Ice Skeleton Skull (3), Red Shocker Piece (5)
Description: Grand Master Basic attack that hits your all around. Replaces Thrash.

Name: Devour
Description: Cleave shape attack dealing damage and heals you based on your missing health. Replaces Cleave.

Name: Ground Shattering
Description: Paralyze all enemies within 3 spaces.

Name: Paralyze Force
Description: Paralyzes all enemies within four spaces. Pure Only.
